summary: Eddie Bravo’s bottom-half material appears as a short section within The Ultimate Rubber Guard.
description: What The Ultimate Rubber Guard offers a reader interested in Eddie Bravo’s half guard.
overview: The Ultimate Rubber Guard includes a bottom-half section in its final volume. The publisher also advertises lockdown and electric-chair material. For someone buying specifically for half guard, the key limitation is its share of the course: the listed Bottom Half section runs 15 minutes 40 seconds, within a release primarily devoted to rubber guard.
